_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); subscription software signals with salesforce.com's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (CRM listed 2004-06-23)

pit_profile.why: 'Salesforce is a global leader in customer relationship management (“CRM”) technology that brings companies and their customers together in the digital age.' 'The market for our service offerings is highly competitive, rapidly evolving and fragmented, and subject to changing technology with low barriers to entry, shifting customer needs and frequent introductions of new products and services.' 'The markets in which we participate are intensely competitive, and if we do not compete effectively, our operating results could be harmed.' (FY2022 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K read calls the business cyclical ('cyclical' appears only of the economy's downturns); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a subscription software company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': the FY2022 10-K names cloud computing as salesforce.com's own model, the side that displaces on-premise software, not a substitute for it, and names no offshore delivery; ECOMMERCE, STREAMING, ENERGY_TRANSITION, EV and CRYPTO name no software business), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

(FY2022 10-K); DURABLE: no 10-K read calls the business cyclical ('cyclical' appears only of the economy's downturns); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a subscription software company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': the FY2022 10-K names cloud computing as salesforce.com's own model, the side that displaces on-premise software, not a substitute for it, and names no offshore delivery; ECOMMERCE, STREAMING, ENERGY_TRANSITION, EV and CRYPTO name no software business), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 0.42x; +96% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.58; conservative 2yr +11%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (no EPS change in FY18-FY18 to measure: the 0% cap); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +50.6%/yr (Q3 FY23 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 5.6-yr ex-FY13 ex-FY14 ex-FY15 ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 ex-FY22 median

BULL.desc: EPS +50.6%/yr (no FY18-FY18 CAGR to measure: BASE's rate); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +50.6%/yr (no 2-yr run in FY18-FY18: BULL's rate); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: CRM (retrospective, 2022-09-09) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.42x (59.1% downside to Bear $66.46 / +141.3% upside to Bull $392.39) | Adj composite 1.46 vs market 2.04: gap -0.58 [OVERVALUED] | +96% above the EPP floor $83.07 (213x FY23E $0.39) | Conservative 2-yr case: +11.3% total (+5.6%/yr) | At 416.9x FY23E the 15% hurdle price $215.03 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue +21.8% YoY in Q2 FY23, forward revenues +13.9-14.1% (Q3 FY23 revenue guide (Q2 FY23 release)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
